method: Assistant-authored manual visual review. Text describes each fitted ISP render relative to Default ISP; it is not human-annotated ground truth.
limitations: Descriptions are subjective visual notes, not validated ground truth. Unreviewed scenes have no generated descriptors.

annotation_process.underlying_model_identifier: Not exposed in session metadata; unavailable for exact attribution.
annotation_process.model_name_reported_by_user: GPT-5.6 Luna; visible in a user-provided screenshot labeling a report-verification execution, so not independently confirmed for the original annotation turns.
annotation_process.annotation_mode: Assistant-authored visual review; no batch vision-language model generated the committed descriptions.
annotation_process.visual_inputs: The comparison sheets displayed Expert TIFF, Default ISP, and fitted ISP panels. The text was intended to describe the fitted render relative to Default ISP, not the Expert TIFF. The Expert TIFF was visible as context, so this was not a blinded study.
annotation_process.prompt_record: No fixed per-image model prompt or command was used to generate these descriptions. They were written interactively in chat; the guidance below is a reconstruction, not a verbatim prompt.
annotation_process.reconstructed_guidance: For each fit, compare Default ISP with the fitted ISP render. Write short, natural, image-specific lines about the processing effect, perceived mood, concrete scene details as rendered, and a cautious style association. Do not write commands, infer hidden camera settings or photographer intent, name expert letters, or compare with other experts. Avoid reusing wording for distinct fits in the same scene.

groups.D1: Visible fit effect such as light, warmth, color, contrast, or detail.
groups.D2: Perceptual mood of the fitted output.
groups.D3: Concrete scene elements as they appear in the fitted output.
groups.D4: Cautious style or cinematic association for the fitted output.

annotation_process.local_vlm_pilot: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct was tested separately on Default-versus-expert pairs and was not used for these labels. It reversed a known brightness difference and missed warmth; its captions were rejected.
annotation_process.validation: The loader checks five fits per scene, nonempty D1-D4 fields, and no repeated phrase within a scene and descriptor group. Tests enforce concise D1/D3 lines and pending-state behavior for unreviewed fits.
